description: An API Gateway built on Spring Framework and Spring Boot providing routing and more.

latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Update Maven wrapper to 3.9.16 by @spring-builds in https://github.com/spring-cloud/spring-cloud-gateway/pull/4266
* Fix forwarded headers for untrusted proxies by @Manihass-Ch in https://github.com/spring-cloud/spring-cloud-gateway/pull/4271
* Bump antora from 3.2.0-rc.2 to 3.2.0-rc.3 in /docs by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/spring-cloud/spring-cloud-gateway/pull/4273
* Filter out synthetic and anonymous types when registering hints by @ryanjbaxter in https://github.com/spring-cloud/spring-cloud-gateway/pull/4277
* Bump antora from 3.2.0-rc.3 to 3.2.0 in /docs by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/spring-cloud/spring-cloud-gateway/pull/4281
* Dispose upstream connection when a cancelled exchange discards the response in `NettyRoutingFilter` by @raccoonback in https://github.com/spring-cloud/spring-cloud-gateway/pull/4283
* Update Antora UI bundle to v0.4.26 by @spring-builds in https://github.com/spring-cloud/spring-cloud-gateway/pull/4295
* Update Maven wrapper to 3.10.0 by @spring-builds in https://github.com/spring-cloud/spring-cloud-gateway/pull/4304
* Bump antora from 3.2.0 to 3.2.1 in /docs by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/spring-cloud/spring-cloud-gateway/pull/4312
* Bump @antora/atlas-extension from 1.0.0-alpha.5 to 1.0.0-alpha.6 in /docs by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/spring-cloud/spring-cloud-gateway/pull/4311

## New Contributors
* @Manihass-Ch made their first contribution in https://github.com/spring-cloud/spring-cloud-gateway/pull/4271

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/spring-cloud/spring-cloud-gateway/compare/v5.0.3...v5.0.4
